about_the_game:
Welcome to Store Keeper — a game where you take on the role of a large wholesale warehouse manager!
Your task is to establish a seamless logistics operation: from receiving goods from suppliers to delivering them to retail stores. Smart inventory management, precise calculations, and efficient space organization will help you build a warehouse that runs like clockwork.

Key Features:

🔹 Receiving and Inspecting Shipments


Monitor incoming goods, check invoices, and identify supplier errors. Decide how to handle defective or surplus products. Every decision impacts your reputation and profits.

🔹 Optimizing Warehouse Space


Arrange products strategically to speed up shipments and minimize losses. Upgrade warehouse facilities and organize storage areas for maximum efficiency.

🔹 Maintaining Proper Storage Conditions


Certain products require special storage conditions: refrigerated goods must be kept in cooling chambers, while dry goods should be stored in well-ventilated areas. Manage warehouse resources wisely to streamline storage and shipping processes.

🔹 Order Analysis and Inventory Management

Track store demands, forecast trends, and prevent stock shortages or overflows. Plan purchases strategically to keep your warehouse profitable.

Can you build the perfect logistics system and become a true master of warehouse management? Test your skills in Store Keeper!
